title: How to Watch ‘America’s Next Top Model’ Online for Free
summary: On the heels of a Netflix tell-all, fans are revisiting the show to support their favorites, and to look back at the wild on-set moments discussed in the doc.

America’s Next Top Model is back in the spotlight after a shocking Netflix documentary alleged mistreatment of contestants, producer manipulation and behind-the-scenes drama among the cast and crew.

GET APPLE TV FREE TRIAL HERE

Reality Check: Inside America’s Next Top Model premiered Feb. 16 on Netflix with the three-episode docuseries streaming online now. The new doc has not only raised new questions about the popular modeling competition show but also renewed interest in the original series, which ran from 2003 to 2018. Though it’s been long off the air, fans are revisiting the show to support their favorites, and to look back at some of the wild on-set moments discussed in the doc (think: an eyebrow-raising race-swapping photo shoot, makeover meltdowns, or the time host Tyra Banks pressured a contestant into closing the gap between her teeth).

Want to watch America’s Next Top Model online? Here’s what you need to know.

How to Watch America’s Next Top Model Online

The Tyra Banks-created show ran for a total of 24 cycles on television across UPN, The CW and VH1. Only cycles 1-22 are available to stream online at this time (the final two seasons aired on VH1 and the network has yet to release them for streaming).

You can watch almost every cycle of America’s Next Top Model online through Apple TV (formerly known as Apple TV+). The streaming service lets you watch every episode from season 1 to season 22 on-demand at-home. Even better: Apple TV currently offers a free trial that you can use to watch America’s Next Top Model online for free.

Apple TV is also the home to shows like The Morning Show, Severance and Shrinking , plus live sports like F1 races, Major League Soccer, Major League Baseball and more. Get a 7-day risk-free trial here to watch ANTM online free, then continue on with an Apple TV subscription from just $12.99/month.

You can also watch America’s Next Top Model through Hulu, which has the first 16 seasons streaming online. Hulu currently offers a 30-day free trial that you can use to stream ANTM online for free. That’s more than enough time to catch up on the modeling reality show and check out Hulu’s other shows and movies like Tell Me Lies, The Beauty , Futurama and the new JFK Jr. and Carolyn Bessette series , Love Story.

Both Apple TV and Hulu let you watch America’s Next Top Model on your computer, tablet, smartphone or on TV (via their streaming apps).

Seasons 1-22 of America’s Next Model are also available through Amazon Prime Video . You can purchase individual episodes to watch or download entire seasons, with pricing start at $2.99 . Select seasons are also available to view online through  Pluto TV .

While the Reality Check documentary is only streaming on Netflix right now and not available to stream or download on Prime Video, Amazon does have this tell-all book from popular Cycle 9 contestant Sarah Hartshorne.

Titled A Memoir of Makeovers, Manipulation, and Not Becoming America’s Next Top Model, the book delves into the plus-size contestant’s experience with auditioning for the show, filming the made-for-TV challenges, and what it felt like inside the L.A. “model house” which was “teeming with hidden cameras and elaborately constructed tensions.”

Per a book description: “As the season unfolds and the producers’ interview questions about her weight and her opinions of the other girls become increasingly pointed, Hartshorne uncovers the destabilizing methods employed to film ‘reality.'”

Banks and ANTM producer Ken Mok have denied any allegations raised in Hartshorne’s book and in the documentary, insisting that they were there to film a reality TV show and always had the contestants’ — and viewers’ — interests at heart.
